title: Single Change-Point Detection via Energy Distance with Application to Genomic Data
summary: In this paper, we develop and analyze a nonparametric procedure for detecting a single change point in sequences of independent observations using energy distance. The asymptotic properties of the test statistic are derived under both null and alternative hypotheses. Under the null hypothesis, for any fixed candidate split point, the standardized statistic $\mathcal{Z}_{n,k}$ converges to a standard normal limit.
